rules: Fork HEAD is an observation, not an approved donor import pin or released dependency.
An unregistered fork may be studied without increasing the exact 92-donor baseline; any material reuse requires canonical donor records, path-level provenance, licenses, tests and notice updates.
A different fork upstream must never inherit another donor's rights, source hashes or approved pin.
A documented donor does not become runtime-integrated, packaged or shipped merely because a fork exists.
All finance execution, evidence, AI and Artifact permissions remain with canonical LiOS P5/P7/P11/P4/GM owners.
Controlled forks must record delta-review state, material-delta disposition, rights/provenance gate and a concrete next-review trigger; observed fork HEAD alone never promotes integration truth.
